2608.20936.title: Graph-Operator World Models for Morphology-Parameter Generalization in Continuous Control
2608.20936.paper_summary: World models for continuous control are commonly trained for a fixed physical system and can degrade when known morphology parameters such as link lengths, masses, damping, and actuation change. Existing approaches often provide these parameters as conditioning information, but leave unspecified which part of the learned transition should remain reusable and which part should change with morphology. We propose Graph-Operator World Models (GraphOp-WM), a structured world model for generalization across unseen morphology parameters within related articulated robot families. GraphOp-WM represents bodies and their kinematic relations as an attributed graph and factorizes each transition into a morphology-independent local dynamics basis and a morphology-conditioned structured operator. The operator combines node-local modulation, kinematic-tree coupling, and a low-rank global correction, while architectural information separation, basis normalization, and paired-morphology supervision encourage static morphology dependence to be carried by the operator pathway. Graph-level readout and edge-wise action representations provide a compatible interface for reward, value, and TD-MPC-style planning. We further define controlled MuJoCo parameter splits covering interpolation, extrapolation, and held-out compositions of link geometry, mass, damping, and actuation parameters in Hopper, Walker2d, and HalfCheetah.
2608.20936.paper_summary_zh: 連續控制的世界模型通常是針對固定的物理系統進行訓練的，當已知的形態參數如連桿長度、質量、阻尼和驅動方式發生變化時，模型可能會退化。現有的方法通常將這些參數作為條件信息提供，但未明確指出學習到的轉換中哪一部分應保持可重用，哪一部分應隨著形態而改變。我們提出了圖操作世界模型（GraphOp-WM），這是一種結構化的世界模型，用於在相關的關節機器人家族中對未見形態參數進行泛化。GraphOp-WM將物體及其運動關係表示為一個帶屬性的圖，並將每個轉換分解為一個與形態無關的局部動力學基礎和一個與形態相關的結構化操作符。該操作符結合了節點局部調制、運動樹耦合和低秩全局修正，而架構信息分離、基礎正規化和配對形態監督則鼓勵靜態形態依賴由操作符路徑攜帶。圖級讀出和邊緣動作表示提供了與獎勵、價值和TD-MPC風格規劃兼容的接口。我們進一步定義了控制的MuJoCo參數分割，涵蓋了Hopper、Walker2d和HalfCheetah中的連桿幾何、質量、阻尼和驅動參數的插值、外推和保留組合。
